# Bravo Limo

> Bravo Limo provides chauffeured limousine, party bus, Mercedes Sprinter and airport transportation across New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, Connecticut and South Florida. Pricing is itinerary-based and shown online before booking.

## Key facts

- Phone: 610-702-0110
- Email: info@bravo.limo
- Hours: Reservations & dispatch daily, 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM
- Location: 18 N 7th Street, Stroudsburg, PA 18360
- Location: 330 Vreeland Ave, Paterson, NJ 07513
- Online booking: https://bravo.limo/rent-limousine-online-form/
- Fleet size: 22 vehicles, 2–50 passengers
- Policies: alcohol only for passengers 21+ where permitted; never on prom or school trips; no smoking or vaping.
